connector.name: Omni MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: All-in-one MCP server: GitHub, Git, Slack, web fetch, memory, and filesystem. Agent Mode opt-in.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package omni-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bitofacoder account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub token for the GitHub tools (optional)

env.name: OMNI_AGENT_MODE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable Agent Mode (shell execution and file writes). Disabled by default.
